variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables start with $. Use 'const' for class/namespace constants and 'define()' for global constants.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: PHP supports scalar, compound, and special types. Type hinting can enforce types in PHP 7+.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Use '===' for strict comparison. The nullsafe '?->' operator prevents errors on null object access.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: PHP 8 'match' expressions are safer and more concise than 'switch' statements.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: 'foreach' is the standard way to iterate over arrays and traversable objects.

while_loop.title: While Loop

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Use strict typing ('declare(strict_types=1);'). Arrow functions capture variables from the parent scope automatically.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: PHP arrays are ordered maps. Use short array syntax '[]' instead of 'array()'.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Associative arrays are the primary map-like structure in PHP. Keys can be integers or strings.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Always catch specific exceptions rather than Throwable unless implementing a top-level handler.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: PHP provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: PHP supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: PHP provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: PHP converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: PHP represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: PHP formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: PHP branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: PHP defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: PHP iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: PHP organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: PHP stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: PHP groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: PHP tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: PHP organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
